```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library("GimmeMyOmics")
library("GimmmeMySC")
library("rlist")
library("cowplot")
library("kableExtra")
library("openxlsx")

path <- file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
)
path_fig <- file.path(dirname(getwd()), "vignettes", "figures", "enrichment")

source(file.path(path, "conf.R"))

if (species == "human") {
  org_lib <- "org.Hs.eg.db"
} else {
    org_lib <- "org.Mm.eg.db"
}
library(org_lib, character.only = TRUE)
filter <- dplyr::filter
select <- dplyr::select
rename <- dplyr::rename
```

### ORA
```{r}
l_ora <- list.map(
  l_dea,
  f(x) ~enrichGO(
    gene = pull(x, "gene_name"),
    OrgDb = get(org_lib),
    keyType = "ALIAS",
    ont = "ALL",
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    qvalueCutoff = 1,
    universe = Features(seurat)
  )
)
```

```{r}
list.map(
    l_ora ,
    f(x, y, z) ~ {
      plot_enrich(
        x,
        cex = 0.65,
        label_x = "generatio",
        method = "ora",
        # regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional,
        n = 15,
        title = z,
        name_id = "GeneRatio"
      )
    }
) %>% 
  compact() %>%
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, nrow = 2, align = "hv")

list.map(l_ora, f(i) ~print_enrich(i, method = method) %>% nrow()) %>%
    list.cbind() %>%
    set_rownames("# Pathway GO") %>%
    kable0()

list.map(
  l_ora,
  f(i, j, k) ~ {
    tmp <- print_enrich(
      i, 
      regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional
    )
    if (nrow(tmp) > 1)
  heatmap_enrich_full(
    l_ora[[j]],
    l_dea[[j]],
    regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional,
    width_text = 100
  ) + labs( title = paste("Cluster", k), y = NULL, x = NULL) +
     theme_custom()
  }
) %>%
  compact() %>%
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, nrow = NULL, align = "hv")
 

omics2excel(
  l_ora, 
  file = file.path(path, "ora.xlsx"), 
  func = function(x) print_enrich(x, method = "ora")
)
```

### GSEA
```{r}
var <- "gene_name"

l_deg_ranked <- list.map(
    l_dea_proc,
    f(x) ~ {
        metric <- "log2FoldChange"
        de_genes_ranked <- top_genes(x, 0.01, 1, n = Inf) %>% #, rank = TRUE) %>%
            # mutate(ranked_padj = sign(log2FoldChange) * (log10(padj))) %>%
            pull(metric, name = var) %>%
            sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>%
            .[!is.na(names(.))] %>%
            .[is.finite(.)] %>%
            .[!duplicated(.)]
    }
)

l_gsea <- list.map(
    l_deg_ranked,
    f(x) ~ {
        gseGO(
            x,
            ont = "ALL",
            OrgDb = get(org_lib),
            keyType = "ALIAS",
            verbose = FALSE
        ) %>%
            # setReadable(org_lib, 'ENSEMBL') %>%
            suppressWarnings() %>%
            invisible()
    }
)
```

```{r}
list.map(
    l_gsea,
    f(x, y, z) ~ {
      plot_enrich(
        x,
        cex = 0.65,
        label_x = "NES",
        method = "gsea",
        # regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional,
        n = 15,
        title = z
      )
    }
) %>%
  compact() %>%
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, nrow = 2, align = "hv")

list.map(l_gsea, f(i) ~print_enrich(i, method = "gsea") %>% nrow()) %>%
    list.cbind() %>%
    set_rownames("# Pathway GO") %>%
    kable0()

omics2excel(
  l_gsea, 
  file = file.path(path, "gsea.xlsx"), 
  func = function(x) print_enrich(x, method = "gsea")
)
```

```{r}
list.map(
    l_gsea,
    f(i, j, k) ~ {
        tmp <- print_enrich(
            i,
            method = "gsea",
            regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional
        )
        if (nrow(tmp) > 1)
            heatmap_enrich_full(
                l_gsea[[j]],
                l_dea[[j]],
                method = "gsea",
                regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional,
                width_text = 100
            ) + labs( title = paste("Cluster", k), y = NULL, x = NULL) +
            theme_custom()
    }
)  %>%
    compact() %>%
    plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, nrow = NULL, align = "hv")
```
